introduction: SYNOPSISMina's parents tries to marry her off to loan shark Young-gwon when they are not able to pay him back. Mina retaliates by running away. She finds a job in a small cafe by the beach and convinces the owner to fix the place up to attract the area's influential men. To get back at Young-gwon, she gives herself to Manager Lee of the local organization. She begins to take photos of her liaison's with influential men who frequent her cafe and gives them to Young-gwon when he comes to get her back.
